scope: Adaptive acquisition of unknown-rank predictive models from raw trajectories of general controlled finite-state processes.
scoped_result: For the explicit deterministic rank-4 HMM in REPORT.txt, an adaptive policy identifies the realized predictive state in exactly 2 actions, while every fixed open-loop schedule requires exactly 3 actions even with full raw trajectory data.
open_gaps: The process transition and emission kernels are supplied; only the realized hidden predictive state is acquired.
No result is proved for unknown-rank Hankel-basis discovery.
No noisy-emission or arbitrary controlled-HMM minimax theorem is established.
